title: Painlev\'e equations
exact_target: Create reliable mathematical and numerical resources for Painlevé functions, including pole locations, asymptotics and connection formulae.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8000004 (AMR-079-0004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some open problems in random matrix theory and the theory of integrable systems (2007), arXiv:0712.0849, Problem 4.

status_qualification: The source expressly calls this a large-scale project. Its example asks about a Painlevé II solution asymptotic to the Airy function as $x\to+\infty$ and the location of complex poles; it is not a claim about all Painlevé solutions simultaneously.
